Subject: Candidate offer for Amelia Porter — SDE2 (for internal signoff)

Hi Hiro —

Thanks for taking this. Attaching the proposed offer for Amelia Porter (SDE2). She has two competing offers; her preference is Redwood but she asked for clarification on base vs. total on-call bonus cadence and the RSU cadence (4-year with 25% cliff).

Proposed:
- Base: $160,000
- Target bonus: 10% (annual, discretionary)
- RSUs: $80,000 grant value (4y, standard vest schedule)
- Relocation: NA (remote, US)

Attached: "Redwood_Offer_AmeliaPorter_v1.pdf" and comp-breakdown. Can you confirm we can approve as-is or if we should bump base / adjust RSU? Hiring manager (Marissa) is copied. Natasha

--

natasha@talentworks.com

Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Candidate offer for Amelia Porter — SDE2 (for internal signoff)

Looping you both for comp sign-off. Quick context: Amelia is strong IC; team needs this role filled early Q1. Natasha listed $160k base / $80k RSU. My initial read: base is slightly below market for SF-remote SDE2. Two options: 1) approve as proposed to keep offer conservative; 2) approve with $10k base bump to $170k and keep RSUs the same to improve competitiveness.

Questions for compensation:
- If we increase base to $170k, does comp budget allow?
- Any concern on approving the 10% discretionary bonus vs. switching to 7.5% fixed OTE?

Please see attached comp sheet. Marissa — what is manager preference?

Thanks,
Hiro

Subject: Re: Fwd: Candidate offer for Amelia Porter — SDE2 (for internal signoff)

Hiro / Laura / Marissa —

Checked budget and comp bands. Notes: SDE2 band midpoint for US-remote currently $165k. Approving base at $160k is technically within band but low-side. We can do $170k base only if we move from band midpoint budget for H2 hires into stretch. That would require manager justification (high priority req) and CSO sign-off for the band stretch.

Recommendation:
- If hiring manager flags high urgency (Marissa to confirm), approve $170k base + $80k RSU. If not urgent, approve $160k base + $80k RSU but include a signing bonus of $7,500 to close the gap (one-time).

Also: Change bonus language to "target" (discretionary) is fine; we should avoid guaranteed OTE changes.

Attaching standard approval template and a quick note for Marissa to confirm urgency.

Priyom Das
Director, Total Rewards
Redwood Inference

[attachment: comp-approval-template.docx]

Thanks team — quick response. This role is high priority: pipeline has a hard blocker on infra work and Amelia has the exact domain experience we need. Manager here: please approve the $170k base with $80k RSU and no change to bonus (10% target). I authorize the band stretch for this hire.

Confirming sign-off for HR to send revised offer. Marissa
